command:
set -euo pipefail
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin:$PATH"
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_BRANCH=f38c8b41701dfea62cb2d44d409dcb2de6da38a3
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 scripts/apply_chat_relay_explicit_lease_fix.py
rm scripts/apply_chat_relay_explicit_lease_fix.py
git diff --check
gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayDownlinkPumpTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayBackendTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayTurnPacingTest --no-daemon
gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon
git add -A
git commit -m 'fix: pass relay endpoint lease explicitly'
git push origin HEAD:agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_explicit_lease_green=true
echo relay_explicit_lease_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
